about: WP Job Portal sample data. Read by WPJOBPORTAL_Sample_Data_Importer. Every company and person here is fictional; addresses use example.com, which is reserved for examples. A record with "requires" is imported only when that add-on module is active, so every count on every dashboard is true for the site it lands on.

companies.name: Brightpath Solutions
companies.tagline: Software that grows with your business
companies.description:
Brightpath Solutions builds web and mobile software for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team of forty designers, engineers and support specialists works closely with each client, from the first workshop to long after launch.

We offer flexible hours, a yearly learning budget and a hybrid office.

companies.name: Skyline Digital
companies.description: Skyline Digital is a content and social media agency. We plan, write and run campaigns for brands in retail, travel and education.

companies.name: Harbor Analytics
companies.description: Harbor Analytics helps finance and operations teams turn their numbers into decisions, with reporting, forecasting and data clean-up projects.

jobs.title: Senior PHP Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced PHP developer to lead the back end of our client projects.

  • Design and build features in PHP and MySQL
  • Review code and mentor two junior developers
  • Work with designers and clients to plan each release

You have four or more years of PHP, know a modern framework or WordPress well, and write tests as a habit.

jobs.title: Front-End Developer
jobs.description:
Join our front-end team and turn designs into fast, accessible web pages.

  • Build responsive layouts in HTML, CSS and JavaScript
  • Keep pages accessible and quick to load
  • Fix bugs reported by clients and testers

A portfolio of two or three sites you have built is more useful to us than a degree.

jobs.title: UX Designer
jobs.description:
Shape how our clients' customers find their way around websites and apps.

  • Run interviews and usability tests
  • Sketch flows and build clickable prototypes
  • Hand designs to developers and stay with them through launch

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist
jobs.description:
Be the person our clients call first. You answer questions, train new users and pass ideas back to the product team.

Patience, clear writing and a liking for solving problems matter more than experience.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description: Twenty hours a week, planning our newsletter, case studies and event calendar. A good fit for someone who enjoys writing and keeping a schedule.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern
jobs.description: A three-month paid internship for a student who has built something of their own. You will pair with a senior developer on real client work.

jobs.title: Content Strategist
jobs.description: Plan what our clients publish and why. You set the calendar, brief writers and report on what worked.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description: Run day-to-day social accounts for three client brands, from posts and replies to monthly reports.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: Clean, join and explain data for our finance clients. SQL every day, Python on most days, and a dashboard tool of your choice.

jobs.title: Management Accountant
jobs.description: Own monthly reporting and budgets for a portfolio of clients, and help them plan the year ahead.
